title: Primary nav (≤5)
description: Closed-loop / runtime overviews only. Spine: Overview → Problem → Design → Day 1 → Landing. The Day-1 tab is a copyable recipe, not a migration schedule.
antiPatterns: competitors or full task DAG on overview by default
using this pack for design-doc unless the user has a real Day-1 recipe
labeling a migration/backlog tab as Day 1
teaching dual wait / cursor read on day-1 overview
Play/Step/demo chrome without per-frame insight and structural change
acceptance matrix or L0–Ln backlog on the primary view
agentPrompt: Build a composition Canvas with ≤5 ordered Tabs (ids: overview primary, problem, design, path, landing). Resolve visible labels from i18n/nav.json using locale= (labels[id][locale] ?? labels[id].en ?? view.label). path = Day-1 copyable commands/recipe (≤4). Do not put implementation phases on path. Default STATIC product design. Start from templates/overview.canvas.tsx and rewrite all user-visible copy into the user's language. Prefer this pack only with content=closed-loop. See references/methodology.md Pack selection.
